briefdescription.para: Returns a REP STOS instruction, possibly with a few load/stores to implement a constant size memory set.

detaileddescription.para: In some cases where we know REP MOVS is inefficient we return an empty SDValue so the calling code can either generate a store sequence or call the runtime memset function.

inbodydescription.para: In case we optimize for size, we use repstosb even if it's less efficient so we can save the loads/stores of the leftover.
RepStos can process the whole length.

inbodydescription.para: In case we optimize for size, we use repmovsb even if it's less efficient so we can save the loads/stores of the leftover.
